scope: Two adjacent 20 m / 25 m double-track bays, three elevated support lines and 20 m adjoining at-grade transition. SUP-65 is a ground-zone check location, not an invented bridge pier.
site_inputs_required: Adopted railway standards and code editions
Survey/alignment, curvature, skew and rail movement datum
Railway service, derailment, fatigue, wind and seismic actions
Boreholes, groundwater, axial/lateral soil response and settlement
Sulfate/chloride exposure where present and treatment compatibility trials
Liquefaction, flood levels, scour and surface flood pathways where relevant
Supplier reinforcement/prestress, end zones, transfer/handling strengths and mould/bed limits
Measured net detail masses, centre of gravity, transport axle loads and route clearances
Lifting chart/configuration/radius, rigging, temporary stability and support-ground capacity
Accepted rainfall/storm ensemble, catchments, culvert sizing and outfall consent/tailwater
Connection tolerances, loads, movement and inspection acceptance values
Supplier-installed cost/time, service life, maintenance capability and discount basis
Independent check, physical first article evidence and signed authority release

connections.title: Pier to foundation
connections.applicable_loads: axial, moment, shear, seismic cyclic demand
connections.installation_sequence: Survey starter bars/socket; trial fit; brace; grout/cure before loading
connections.inspection: Survey alignment; reinforcement/coupler record; grout strength and fill evidence
connections.repair_method: Engineer-designed local repair or replacement; retain access

connections.title: Cap to column
connections.applicable_loads: vertical reactions, torsion, transverse loads and seismic
connections.installation_sequence: Brace cap; verify interface; complete continuity/grout; strength hold point
connections.inspection: Joint dimensions, engagement and void checks; as-built survey
connections.repair_method: Accessible repair ports and approved temporary support

connections.title: Girder bearings and restraints
connections.applicable_loads: vertical uplift, braking, lateral, thermal, seismic and derailment
connections.installation_sequence: Survey seats; set orientation and movement datum; place beam; engage restraints
connections.inspection: Seat levels, bearing rotation/contact, travel, fixity and restraint witness
connections.repair_method: Isolate traffic; use reviewed jacking seats; replace bearing and resurvey

connections.title: Walkway and containment attachments
connections.applicable_loads: egress crowd, containment impact and fatigue
connections.installation_sequence: Cast inserts; gauge fit; install panels and barriers with movement allowance
connections.inspection: Anchor engagement/proof evidence, gaps, containment continuity and access
connections.repair_method: Remove replaceable panels and bolts from protected work area

connections.title: Track plinth and fastener anchors
connections.applicable_loads: vertical axle, lateral, braking, fatigue and rail interaction
connections.installation_sequence: Survey rail seats; qualify anchor/grout system; fit and gauge fasteners
connections.inspection: Gauge, level, pull-out qualification, torque and electrical insulation
connections.repair_method: Exchange fasteners or local plinth repair with track possession

connections.title: Drainage and utility crossings
connections.applicable_loads: water pressure, utility weight, thermal movement and accidental loads
connections.installation_sequence: Set falls and movement loops; separate utilities; seal joints; commission drainage
connections.inspection: Survey falls; leak/flow and blockage-access checks; utility clearance
connections.repair_method: Accessible clean-outs and replaceable flexible connections

connections.title: Jacking and bearing replacement
connections.applicable_loads: jacking reactions, temporary redistribution, lateral stability
connections.installation_sequence: Approve possession/supports; install synchronised monitored jacks at designed seats
connections.inspection: Jack calibration, seat capacity, lift limits and stable temporary load path
connections.repair_method: Replace bearing; controlled lowering; movement datum and track survey

failure_modes.title: Blocked drainage
failure_modes.controls: Accessible drains; redundant route where justified; geometry monitoring and intervention
failure_modes.required_evidence: Blockage/backwater replay, cleaning trial, settlement model and geometry intervention review

failure_modes.title: Girder instability during lifting
failure_modes.controls: Reviewed sling geometry, centre of gravity, temporary bracing and exclusion zone
failure_modes.required_evidence: Weighed member, lift chart/radius, stability calculation and witnessed first lift

failure_modes.title: Incorrect bearing installation
causal_chain: restraint or loss of bearing contact
failure_modes.controls: Surveyed seats and movement/fixity datum; witness installation
failure_modes.required_evidence: Bearing schedule, seat survey and installation inspection

failure_modes.title: Grout defects
failure_modes.controls: Qualified grouting procedure, mock-up, fill witness and strength hold
failure_modes.required_evidence: Batch/strength records, void/engagement inspection and connection qualification

failure_modes.title: Insufficient transfer strength
causal_chain: loss of prestress or handling failure
failure_modes.controls: No transfer or handling before reviewed measured strength
failure_modes.required_evidence: Specimen maturity/strength, transfer procedure and end-zone inspection

failure_modes.title: Crane or launcher support failure
causal_chain: weak support or excessive ground pressure
failure_modes.controls: Ground investigation, outrigger/launcher foundation and temporary works review
failure_modes.required_evidence: Support loadcase, bearing/settlement calculations, survey and trial load

failure_modes.title: Transition/scour deterioration
causal_chain: outfall erosion or transition stiffness change
failure_modes.controls: Scour protection, graded stiffness and drainage access
failure_modes.required_evidence: Flood/scour assessment, transition settlement model and inspection trigger

bearings.candidate_layout: Two bearing seats per beam end; 16 seats across four beams. Fixed/guided/free arrangements and capacities remain unselected.

construction_sequence.activity: Freeze layout, railway loads and surveyed ground/drainage basis
construction_sequence.hold_point: Independent reviewed design and safe working constraints

construction_sequence.activity: Compare foundations and ground treatment; install/test supports ahead of erection
construction_sequence.hold_point: Measured load tests, settlement and chemistry compatibility; released temporary works
Reviewed reinforcement/prestress, transfer strength, mass and lifting hardware records

construction_sequence.activity: Survey bearing seats and install bearings/restraints
construction_sequence.hold_point: Seat levels, orientation, capacities and movement datum accepted

construction_sequence.activity: Transport and lift first beam; brace before releasing rigging
construction_sequence.hold_point: Reviewed actual lift configuration, stability and equipment support; witness first article

construction_sequence.activity: Erect paired beam and finish connections, walkway and containment
construction_sequence.hold_point: Connection strength/fill, engagement, survey and temporary support release

construction_sequence.activity: Construct approach/trackform, catchment and drainage interfaces
construction_sequence.hold_point: Settlement/drainage/scour criteria and blockage access checks

construction_sequence.activity: Commission, inspect and establish maintenance access
construction_sequence.hold_point: Geometry, drainage scenarios, jacking/replacement rehearsal; independent and authority acceptance
